name: hopline.places.search
description: Find places and stops by name.

name: hopline.stops.get
description: A stop or station: entrances, platforms, pathways and each facility's status at as_of, with active alerts.

name: hopline.routes.get
description: A route: stop patterns, frequencies per service period, the trip ID rule and active alerts.

name: hopline.departures.list
description: Departures at a stop in a window: scheduled time, live estimate, cancelled or skipped, and the trip update behind it.

name: hopline.trips.plan
description: Up to three itineraries at the run's virtual time, with step-free routing, uses_estimates, blockers, the fare for a card, and the service state used.

name: hopline.alerts.list
description: Alerts with status derived at the virtual time, optionally for a route, stop, facility or status.

name: hopline.alerts.get
description: One alert with its version chain, or one version.

name: hopline.saved.list
description: Saved places and saved commutes.

name: hopline.subscriptions.list
description: Subscriptions with their revisions.

name: hopline.notifications.list
description: Notifications with delivery status as of the virtual time.

name: hopline.cards.get
description: Cards with spendable balance, pending loads, passes, reduced-fare status and weekly cap progress at the virtual time.

name: hopline.cards.history
description: Ledger entries and taps for a card in a window.

name: hopline.fares.products
description: Fares, transfer and cap rules, products and reduced-fare programs (catalog version).

name: hopline.saved.add
description: Save a place, or a commute between two saved places with days, a departure window and preferences (at most 20).

name: hopline.saved.remove
description: Remove a saved place or commute that no subscription refers to.

name: hopline.subscriptions.create
description: Subscribe to a route, stop, facility, saved commute or card (at most 25).

name: hopline.subscriptions.update
description: Change a subscription, or pause or resume it.

name: hopline.subscriptions.delete
description: Delete a subscription (kept as a tombstone with its revisions).

name: hopline.notifications.acknowledge
description: Mark a notification as read.

name: hopline.cards.add_value
description: Load value onto a card; it is pending, and spendable only once the payment settles.

name: hopline.cards.set_autoreload
description: Set or clear (null) a card's autoreload rule; it is checked only after a charged tap.

name: hopline.passes.purchase
description: Buy a monthly pass from the settled balance, for this month or a later one.

name: hopline.passes.cancel
description: Cancel a pass before it starts, with a full refund.

name: hopline.cards.report_lost
description: Block a card at once and issue a virtual replacement carrying its balance, pending loads, passes, reduced fare and cap progress; a $5.00 fee applies.

name: hopline.reduced_fare.apply
description: Apply for a reduced fare (senior, disability or low_income); the decision arrives later.
